ANNOUNCEMENTS

1.        We are celebrating the contributions ofthe Black Community in Montgomery County
          during Black History Month. Diversity and Training Officer, Michelle Lowe, has
          organized a Black History Celebration at Veterans Plaza on February 20 from noon to 3
          p.m. The celebration will feature: Cultural Dance, Art, Storytelling, Poetry/Spoken
          Word, Songs of Faith, Health and Wellness, and Vendors. It is open to
          everyone. Commissioners were sent additional event information today via email.
